subject.title: [Feature]: Fallback approval mode + model attribution in messages

question: Should OpenClaw core add an opt-in per-agent approval gate before automatic model fallback, and if so what approval route and timeout policy should it use?
rationale: The missing behavior is not a strict bug; it adds new config and changes fallback reliability, provider-routing, and channel approval semantics that need maintainer product intent.

options.title: Design a core approval gate
options.body: Add a default-off per-agent fallback approval policy after specifying approval delivery, timeout, fail/proceed behavior, and regression coverage.

options.title: Keep automatic fallback only
options.body: Reject approval gating and rely on existing fallback notices plus `messages.responsePrefix` for transparency.

options.title: Defer to external orchestration
options.body: Leave core unchanged and document that users needing approval before provider changes should orchestrate model selection outside the fallback loop.

recommendation.title: Design a core approval gate
recommendation.body: Add a default-off per-agent fallback approval policy after specifying approval delivery, timeout, fail/proceed behavior, and regression coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans agent model config and fallback policy, and steipete has the strongest history on both surfaces.
